description: Dependency updates for agent-hub. Every setting and rule says why it is here; one without a reason is removed.

lockFileMaintenance.description: uv.lock and package-lock.json also pin transitive packages, which no manifest names: refresh them weekly so their fixes arrive.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix is opened right away, outside the weekly schedule.

packageRules.description: Python 3.14 is the project floor (uuid.uuid7, ADR 0001): never propose a change to requires-python.
The dev tools in pyproject.toml move together: one PR and one make check run instead of eight.
The web app's dev tooling (Vite, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, TypeScript) moves together; the PR must also rebuild the committed web_dist (make web-build), which make check verifies.
The workflows' actions are few and move together.
The Dockerfile pins its base images by digest (ADR 0022): keep the digest on every bump.
A major update changes behaviour: its own PR, labelled for a closer review.
